subject: SOC 2 coverage semantics and sampling point — inclusive end / bridge letter request
messages:
From: SRS Audit <srs-audit@srsaudit.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintop.com
Date: 2027-09-14T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Question on SOC 2 period semantics for FinTop (Jan 1 — Jun 30 2027)

Hi Sean / Marissa,

We're preparing the Type II evaluation for FinTop Analytics (reporting period Jan 1 — Jun 30, 2027). A couple of evidence/boundary clarifications so we can finalize sampling and request the right artifacts from you and the customer: 

1) Cutoff inclusivity: when Redwood certifies a period as "through June 30, 2027" — does that include all activity up to 23:59:59 UTC on 2027-06-30, or do you use a different timezone or definition (e.g., business-day local time)? Please provide the exact sentence we should cite in the audit workpapers.

2) Point-in-time vs rolling evidence: For daily snapshots and token/transaction captures, are the samples taken at a consistent time of day (e.g., 00:00 UTC), or is evidence event-time based? If there are both approaches by data type, please list which uses snapshot (timepoint) vs event stream.

3) Mid-period changes: If any infra/config changes occurred on 2027-06-20 that affect control operation (e.g., KV cache behavior, new routing rules), do you treat those as handled by sampling later in June, or do you provide a bridge letter that documents the change and its effective timestamp?

4) Deliverables: please indicate typical filenames/manifests for the sample lists we should expect (e.g., snapshot-manifest.csv, access-audit-log.zip).

Attached: srs-questionnaire-request.pdf (request index).

Thanks,
Lara Brenner
SRS Audit
(srs-audit@srsaudit.com)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: SRS Audit <srs-audit@srsaudit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, security@fintop.com
Date: 2027-09-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on SOC 2 period semantics for FinTop (Jan 1 — Jun 30 2027)

Lara — thanks for the clear set of questions. Below are our standard semantics and what we can provide for FinTop. Happy to adapt wording if SRS has a preferred phrasing for the workpapers.

1) Cutoff inclusivity: When Redwood states a reporting period is "through June 30, 2027" we include activity up to 23:59:59 UTC on 2027-06-30. If a customer requires a local-time definition (for example, US-Eastern end of day), we will document that explicitly and note the timezone in the manifest. Suggested sentence for your workpapers: "Redwood Inference defines the report cutoff as inclusive of all activity up to 23:59:59 UTC on the stated end date (e.g., 2027-06-30)."

2) Point-in-time vs rolling evidence: Our evidence types are as follows:
- Daily infrastructure snapshots (manifested as KV-cache and config dumps) — captured at 00:00 UTC.
- Transaction logs and event streams — event-time ordered; sampling is performed against event-time ranges.
- Access and auth logs — ingested continuously; for Type II sampling we export discrete windows (e.g., 2027-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2027-06-30T23:59:59Z).

3) Mid-period changes: We document infra/config changes in an annotated change manifest. For material control-impacting changes (e.g., routing/quantization profile rollout, KV cache behavioral changes) we typically provide both:
- An annotated manifest describing the change and effective timestamp, and
- A bridge letter if the change post-dates the report end or if the auditor requests an explicit statement of coverage across the cutover. For changes that occur within the reporting window (e.g., 2027-06-20) we rely on sampling across June plus the manifest; if you prefer an explicit bridge-style statement for clarity in your report, we can provide one.

4) Deliverables / filenames: we'll provide a short evidence bundle — examples: redwood-snapshot-manifest.csv, access-log-export_202706.zip, kv-cache-snapshot-manifest.csv. Attached is a short explainer and the manifest template.

Attachments: redwood-coverage-explainer.pdf; kv-cache-snapshot-manifest.csv

Action: I'll confirm timezone preference with FinTop and can draft the two-line cutoff sentence and optional bridge letter for SRS to include.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, security@fintop.com
Date: 2027-09-14T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on SOC 2 period semantics for FinTop (Jan 1 — Jun 30 2027)

Sean — quick note / proposed next steps: 

- FinTop historically requests local-time framing (they operate US-Eastern). I'll confirm with their security contact (cc'd) whether they prefer the cutoff described in UTC or "US-Eastern (ET)".
- If FinTop wants US-Eastern, we will produce the same manifest wording but replace UTC with "US-Eastern (ET)" and include an explicit conversion example in the manifest.
- Proposal: draft a 1-paragraph bridge letter that states the inclusive cutoff (UTC) and offers coverage through 2027-07-15 as an interim bridge (only if SRS wants it). I can draft the paragraph this afternoon.

Priyom
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: SRS Audit <srs-audit@srsaudit.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, security@fintop.com
Date: 2027-09-14T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on SOC 2 period semantics for FinTop (Jan 1 — Jun 30 2027)

Thanks, Sean (and team). SRS accepts UTC as the default — the suggested sentence below is acceptable for citation in our workpapers: 

"Redwood Inference defines the report cutoff as inclusive of all activity up to 23:59:59 UTC on the stated end date (e.g., 2027-06-30)."

We'd like a short signed bridge letter if Redwood can provide coverage commentary extending the evidence window to 2027-07-15 (simple one-paragraph statement that the controls continued to operate as described between 2027-07-01 and 2027-07-15). Please include the manifest filenames for the sample lists. Once we have the manifest and the one-paragraph bridge, we'll finalize the sampling frame and send the formal evidence request.

Attachment request: sample manifest (redwood-snapshot-manifest.csv) and the list of sample IDs for June (to attach to our workpapers).

Regards,
Lara Brenner
SRS Audit
(srs-audit@srsaudit.com)
